correctness.rationale: Every edge-open packing is uniquely the entire edge set induced by its endpoints, which form disjoint nontrivial stars. Canonical 0/1/2 induced-degree labeling has no center ambiguity. The five specified parent states form an exhaustive disjoint classification, and each recurrence follows by exact enumeration of selected children. Root filtering and forest products finish the all-order proof. Actual packaged script edgeopen_forest_verify.py was executed with ALL_CHECKS_PASSED, including direct edge-condition enumerations on 310855 candidate subsets over 436 nonisomorphic trees, 350018 subsets over 600 random forests, and 98 star checks; the script and output are complete. No inference of infinite truth from experiments.

originality.rationale: The known induced-star structure and the tree optimization theorem are expressly credited. The asserted advance is a disjoint, nonovercounting five-state recursion computing every cardinality coefficient for arbitrary forests; none of the three materially inspected primary papers supplies this all-size enumeration. Formal logic or tree-automaton generality may imply existence of counting algorithms but does not reproduce the specific explicit recurrence. Residual unindexed overlap acknowledged, not represented as a global uniqueness certificate.
residual_risks: Indexed search is not exhaustive: explicit forest EOP enumerators, induced-star-subgraph counting, or color-class enumerators may be unindexed, unpublished, or hidden within a broader graph-polynomial text.

General bounded-treewidth counting metatheorems may imply polynomial-time computability; novelty is claimed for the explicit small disjoint recurrence and its complete coefficients, not for generic tractability.
Later (post-2024) EOP optimization publications screened only at abstract level may contain unstated enumerative refinements; no conclusion about their full documents is asserted.

value.rationale: All-cardinality enumeration of edge-open packings in arbitrary finite forests is a natural refinement of a studied extremal packing quantity. The recurrence is explicit and finite-state, handles arbitrary branching and disconnected components with canonical nonoverlap, returns the exact count of maxima and all other feasible cardinalities, and does not follow numerically from scalar max-value results. Forests are a structurally motivated broad class, not arbitrary finite slices. The result does not claim asymptotic or polynomial-root consequences.
